description: Build an Agoda hotel search link for a Japanese city with dates, guests and rooms pre-filled. Returns a link only: no rates, no booking. Give the user the link exactly as returned, with the disclaimer.

city.description: Japanese city. For a place that is not listed, use the nearest listed city (e.g. Kawasaki → tokyo or yokohama).

currency.description: Currency shown on Agoda. Default: CNY for zh, USD for en, JPY for ja.

language.description: Language of the reply (and of the partner page for links): zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English, ja = Japanese. Use the user's language.

rooms.description: Number of rooms. Default: one room per adult (business travellers rarely share).

name: hotel_search_link
title: Hotel search link (Agoda)
